regions.name: Ngư Ca Xuyên
regions.gloss: River Land of the Fishermen's Songs
regions.image: Vương Bột: ngư chu xướng vãn, fishing boats singing at dusk

holder.name: Lạc Hà Tông
holder.gloss: Sect of the Drifting Sunset Clouds

events.text: Nhan Cô Vụ founds Lạc Hà Tông in the western lands where the sun goes down.
Lạc Hà Tông forges twin swords for its armoury, Tử Điện and Thanh Sương, after the purple lightning and blue frost of an old general's blades.
News of the battle reaches Lạc Hà's seat; the fishing boats do not sing that dusk, for the first time in six hundred years.
Nhan Cô Vụ dies at 790; Trầm Tịch Dương becomes the second head of Lạc Hà Tông.
Trầm Tịch Dương steps down; his disciple Tô Vãn Chiếu becomes head of Lạc Hà Tông and takes the sword Tử Điện.
A girl is born in Lạc Hà Tông on the day the evening glow fills the whole sky; she is named Tô Mộ Vân.

residents.name: Trầm Tịch Dương
residents.role: First elder of Lạc Hà Tông (age 550); its second head, 940-1160, who stepped down for his disciple, the head Tô Vãn Chiếu

residents.name: Tô Mộ Vân
residents.role: The head's youngest disciple, age 24: the world's brightest young talent

seat_of.name: Lạc Hà Tông
seat_of.gloss: Sect of the Drifting Sunset Clouds

events.text: Talisman scribes who painted the clouds of the southern shore found Nam Phố Đường under Lạc Hà.

residents.name: Châu Phi Vân
residents.role: Hall-mistress of Nam Phố Đường, talismans and scribes

seat_of.name: Nam Phố Đường
seat_of.note: Vương Bột: họa đống triêu phi Nam Phố vân (at dawn the painted beams fly with the clouds of the southern shore)

places.name: Hạc Đinh Thị
places.note: Vương Bột: hạc đinh phù chử (crane shoals and wild-duck isles); below Lạc Hà Tông's seat

events.text: A market grows below Lạc Hà's seat among crane shoals and wild-duck isles; it is called Hạc Đinh Thị.
Tô Mộ Vân, fourteen, wins the talisman contest at Hạc Đinh Thị against the scribes of Nam Phố Đường.
Lạc Hà's founder plants maples around the first hall; Phong Lâm Trấn grows among them.
The Tạ family, once great in another land, come to Phong Lâm with nothing but their name, and the swallows of their old hall follow them.
The Tạ and the Vương, old rival clans now far apart, exchange letters for the first time in four hundred years.
Lạc Hà Tông founds Tang Ma Thành among the mulberry and hemp fields of Ngư Ca Xuyên.
Châu Phi Vân is born in Tang Ma Thành; at four she draws her first talisman in mulberry juice.
Tang Ma Thành's hemp ropes are so strong that Lãng Đào's ferrymen will buy no other.
In the Ferry War, Tùng Đào raiders cut every rope bridge on the Ngư Ca border; Tang Ma weaves new ones in a month.
Petals float down the brook at Hoa Khê every spring; lovers drop their names into it.
Silver glints in the river shallows at Ngân Than; Lạc Hà pans it for its coin.
Fragrant grass from Phương Thảo Thôn is woven into the mats of Lạc Hà's meditation halls.
The river mouth at Thủy Khẩu silts up; Lạc Hà's disciples dig it out by hand in one winter.

places.name: Ngọc Nhũ Tuyền
places.note: Warm water among the stone pillars of Ngư Ca Xuyên's karst.

regions.name: Thiên Tuyền Nguyên
regions.gloss: Plain of the Heavenly Jade Wheel
regions.image: Thiên Tuyền (Merak), the Dipper star beside Thiên Xu

famous_sites.name: Thiết Mã Cảnh
famous_sites.note: Lục Du: thiết mã băng hà nhập mộng lai, armoured horses and frozen rivers come into my dreams. Its gate opens inside Chiết Kích Nguyên, near the barrow; whose war it holds is for the history (#27).

famous_sites.name: Cố Lũy
famous_sites.note: Tô Thức: cố lũy tây biên, nhân đạo thị Tam Quốc Chu lang Xích Bích, west of the old ramparts, they say, is where the Three Kingdoms fought. Fallen walls on the edge of Chiết Kích Nguyên; whose they were is for the history (#27).

events.text: Chung Hoài Cực, at 80, founds Thiên Xu Tông under the stars of the Northern Dipper; the ground around his seat grows rich as the sect gathers, and becomes the Bắc Thần Phúc Địa.
Chung Hoài Cực dies at 720; Đỗ Tinh Hà, then 200, becomes the second head of Thiên Xu Tông.
Đỗ Tinh Hà names Quý Trường Kích war marshal of Thiên Xu, and gives him the Thiết Mã banner and its tally.
Đỗ Tinh Hà steps down after 390 years; his disciple Doãn Ngọc Hành becomes head of Thiên Xu Tông and keeper of the Bắc Thần Ấn.

residents.name: Đỗ Tinh Hà
residents.role: First elder of Thiên Xu Tông (age 640); its second head, 760-1150, who stepped down for his disciple, the head Doãn Ngọc Hành

residents.name: Doãn Hi Hòa
residents.role: The head's disciple and presumed heir, age 70

events.text: The star-readers of Củng Tinh Quán finish the Tuyền Cơ Nghi, an armillary that follows the Northern Dipper through the year.
The Tuyền Cơ Nghi shows the Dipper's handle turned toward the heart; Củng Tinh Quán warns of war, and no one listens.
The Tuyền Cơ Nghi goes dark for a whole night; Củng Tinh Quán's star-readers burn incense and wait for war.

residents.name: Thẩm Bắc Thần
residents.role: Head of Củng Tinh Quán, formations and star divination

seat_of.name: Củng Tinh Quán
seat_of.note: Luận Ngữ: like the pole star, which keeps its place while all the stars bow to it (chúng tinh củng chi); a vassal whose name honours its lord, the Heavenly Pivot

places.name: Thiên Quyền Thị
places.note: Thiên Quyền (Megrez), the Dipper star of authority and measure; below Thiên Xu Tông's seat

events.text: A market of weight and measure opens beside Thiên Xu Tông; it is called Thiên Quyền Thị, and its scales are the fairest on the continent.
Under Thiên Xu Tông's protection the traders' crossing grows into Thạch Kiều Thành, the first city of the heart.
Kỳ Tùng Ẩn and Chung Hoài Cực meet at Thạch Kiều Thành and drink for three days; the Pine and the Pivot keep the peace for two centuries.
On the day the Compact is signed, every bell in Thạch Kiều Thành rings without being struck.

In Thạch Kiều Thành, Chung Hoài Cực sets the North Star Compact before the seven sects and stamps it with the Bắc Thần Ấn: land changes hands only by a fall, a gift, an oath or a war the Pivot licenses by writ, and Thiên Xu Tông will enforce it.
The night the founder dies, a boy is born in Thạch Kiều Thành under the fifth star of the Dipper; he is named Doãn Ngọc Hành.
Thạch Kiều Thành's stone bridge, the oldest thing in the heart, is widened for the first time; the old stones are kept in the Pivot's hall.
Doãn Hi Hòa is born in Thạch Kiều Thành at sunrise; Doãn Ngọc Hành takes her as his disciple when she is five.
Scented wood from the groves of Mộc Hương Thôn is burned in the hall of the Pivot.
A boy of Thụ Âm Thôn follows his goat into the miasma and walks out three days later, grey-haired and calm.

places.name: Thần Sa Khoáng
places.note: Cinnabar from the red badlands, the alchemists' first stone.

events.text: Cinnabar is found in the red badlands; Thiên Xu's alchemists open Thần Sa Khoáng.

places.name: Lưu Hoàng Khoáng
places.note: Yellow sulphur crusts in the badlands near the wasteland.

events.text: Sulphur crusts at Lưu Hoàng make the badlands smell of eggs for twenty li; Thiên Xu mines them for fire powders.

places.name: Vẫn Tinh Khoáng
places.note: Iron from a star that fell on the high plain, for Củng Tinh Quán, whose stars bow to the Pivot.

events.text: Iron from a fallen star is dug at Vẫn Tinh; Củng Tinh Quán keeps the mine.

places.name: Tinh Lạc Hồ
places.note: A high lake, 1.2 km up, that holds the Dipper at night; beside Củng Tinh Quán

events.text: Củng Tinh Quán's star-readers find that the high lake Tinh Lạc Hồ holds the Dipper at night as clearly as the sky.

places.name: Thương Ưng Đài
places.note: The high plateau of Thiên Tuyền Nguyên, hunting ground of the grey hawks, near Chiết Kích Nguyên.

regions.name: Ngọc Hành Sơn
regions.image: Ngọc Hành (Alioth), a star of the Northern Dipper

events.text: Smiths who quench star iron in the mountain river found Thối Tinh Môn under Thiên Xu.
Thối Tinh Môn forges the halberd Trầm Sa Kích from star iron for a young officer of Thiên Xu, Quý Trường Kích.
Cát Lưu Quang becomes head of Thối Tinh Môn and forges a blade from the star that fell near Thanh Bách.

residents.name: Cát Lưu Quang
residents.role: Head of Thối Tinh Môn, weapon forging from star iron

seat_of.name: Thối Tinh Môn
seat_of.craft: weapon forging (luyện khí) from star iron
seat_of.note: Star iron quenched in the river; its name follows its lord's stars of the Dipper

events.text: A swordsman who brushes his sleeve and leaves after every deed founds Phất Y Cốc, and digs the ore of Can Tương for its swords.

residents.name: Thang Vô Tạ
residents.role: Head of Phất Y Cốc, sword cultivation and swordsmen for hire

seat_of.name: Phất Y Cốc
seat_of.craft: sword cultivation; wandering swordsmen for hire
seat_of.note: Lý Bạch, Hiệp Khách Hành: sự liễu phất y khứ, thâm tàng thân dữ danh (deed done, he brushes his sleeve and goes, hiding body and name)

places.name: Tinh Hán Thành
places.note: Tào Tháo, Quan Thương Hải: tinh Hán xán lạn, nhược xuất kỳ lý (the bright Milky Way seems to rise out of the sea); Thiên Xu's port on the inland sea

events.text: Thiên Xu Tông founds Tinh Hán Thành, its port on the inland sea, on the reef of the old sea-serpent's bones.
Vệ Văn Cơ is born in Tinh Hán Thành and draws formations in the harbour sand before he can talk.
Thiên Xu's assayers weigh the miners' ore on open scales in the square of Song Kiều; no miner of Ngọc Hành has rebelled since.
The Ôn clan builds the twin bridges of Song Kiều over the river road, and keeps the tolls.
The water mills at Thủy Đối grind the wheat of Thanh Mạch for all of Tinh Hán Thành.
Pearl oysters in the shallows of the inland sea give Châu Bạng Thôn its name and Tinh Hán Thành its pearl trade.

places.name: Thiên Ngoại Khoáng
places.gloss: Mine of the Iron from Beyond the Sky
places.note: Thối Tinh Môn forges star iron, and says this is where it comes from.

events.text: Thối Tinh Môn claims the Mine of the Iron from Beyond the Sky and says its ore fell with the stars.

places.name: Huyền Thiết Khoáng
places.note: Dark heavy iron under Ngọc Hành Sơn.

events.text: Black iron is found deep under the mountain at Huyền Thiết; it is so heavy that a cart carries only one ingot.

places.name: Can Tương Khoáng
places.note: Can Tương, the swordsmith of legend; Phất Y Cốc's swords are forged from its ore.

places.name: Bạch Ngân Khoáng
places.note: Silver below the cinnabar mountain of Đan Sơn Mạch.

events.text: Silver is found below the cinnabar slopes at Bạch Ngân; Thiên Xu's coin is struck from it.

places.name: Thanh Ải Phong
places.note: Vương Duy, Chung Nam Sơn: thanh ải nhập khán vô (the blue haze, walked into, is gone)

events.text: The blue haze on Thanh Ải Phong lifts for a day for the first time in memory; a temple is seen on the summit, and by evening it is gone.

places.name: Cùng Mục Phong
places.note: Vương Chi Hoán: dục cùng thiên lý mục, cánh thướng nhất tầng lâu (to see a thousand li further, climb one storey more)

events.text: Tư Không Hạc Niên duels Thang Vô Tạ of Phất Y Cốc on Cùng Mục Phong for three days; neither wins, and he leaves without a sect.
After the duel on Cùng Mục Phong, Thang Vô Tạ will not speak of it; Phất Y Cốc's disciples climb the peak to see the sword marks.

places.name: Vạn Trùng Hạp
places.note: Lý Bạch: khinh chu dĩ quá vạn trùng sơn (the light boat has passed ten thousand mountains)

events.text: Boats in the gorge of Vạn Trùng Hạp pass ten thousand mountains in a day; the river is the fastest road to the sea.

places.name: Thiết Bối Cốc
places.note: Beasts with iron backs feed on the ore of Ngọc Hành Sơn.

places.name: Xích Viêm Khẩu
places.note: A vent of the volcano in Ngọc Hành Sơn.

regions.name: Thê Ngô Lĩnh
regions.image: The phoenix rests only in the wutong tree (ngô đồng)

events.text: Ngô Thê Đồng founds Phượng Minh Cung on the lands left empty since the fall of Cửu Thiều Cung, 140 years before.
Ngô Thê Đồng dies at 770; Hoa Triêu Dương becomes head of Phượng Minh Cung.
Dying, Ngô Thê Đồng gives Hoa Triêu Dương the Tiêu Thiều Quản and tells her never to play it in full.

residents.name: Vu Ngô Đồng
residents.role: First elder of Phượng Minh Cung (age 320)

events.text: Spirit farmers found Trúc Thực Viên to grow the bamboo seed the phoenix eats.
Ninh Trúc Thực becomes head of Trúc Thực Viên and breeds a bamboo that seeds every year instead of once in sixty.

residents.name: Ninh Trúc Thực
residents.role: Head of Trúc Thực Viên, spirit farming: spirit grain and beast feed

seat_of.name: Trúc Thực Viên
seat_of.craft: spirit farming: spirit grain and beast feed
seat_of.note: The phoenix eats nothing but the seed of the bamboo (Trang Tử)

places.name: Thiều Âm Thị
places.note: The music that brings the phoenix; below Phượng Minh Cung's seat

events.text: Phượng Minh's founder clears the ridges and opens a market of the Shao music at the foot of the new palace: Thiều Âm Thị.
A musician in Thiều Âm Thị plays a tune no one taught him, and every bird on the ridge falls silent; Phượng Minh's elders pay his passage far away.
Wheat fields at Mạch Điền feed the new palace; the town grows around its granary.
Phượng Minh Cung founds Thanh Khê Thành, its port on the gulf.
In the Cinnabar Vein War, Thanh Khê Thành's harbour shelters Phượng Minh's wounded; the city's lanterns burn all year.
Wild peach trees grow over the empty palace grounds; the brook below is named Đào Khê.
The river bend at Hà Loan floods every autumn; its people build their houses on stilts.
Jade-green waves at Bích Lãng carry the fishing boats home from the gulf.

places.name: Tương Phi Đảo
places.note: Its spotted bamboo, stained by the tears of the two consorts of Thuấn

events.text: The spotted bamboo on Tương Phi Đảo is said to be stained by the tears of two consorts; Phượng Minh forbids cutting it.

places.name: Đan Sơn Mạch
places.note: Sơn Hải Kinh's cinnabar mountain is where the phoenix is born. 3 tiles from Thiên Xu's border.

events.text: Phượng Minh finds the Cinnabar Mountain vein near its border with the heart and names it Đan Sơn Mạch.
Thính Vũ Lâu attacks Đan Sơn Mạch, Phượng Minh's cinnabar vein near the heart.
Doãn Ngọc Hành brings Thiên Xu Tông into the war on Phượng Minh's side, to enforce the Compact.
Thính Vũ Lâu is beaten at Đan Sơn Mạch and withdraws; Mạnh Dạ Vũ swears the Pivot will answer for it.

places.name: Cao Cương Phong
places.note: Kinh Thi: phượng hoàng minh hĩ, vu bỉ cao cương, the phoenix sings on that high ridge. A sacred summit (Light).

events.text: Phượng Minh's disciples climb Cao Cương Phong at dawn and say the phoenix sang there, on that high ridge.

places.name: Huyền Viên Lâm
places.note: Jungle below the wutong hills of Thê Ngô Lĩnh, held by dark apes.

places.name: Niết Hỏa Khẩu
places.note: In Thê Ngô Lĩnh, the wutong hills where the phoenix is reborn in fire.

places.name: Lôi Ngô Lâm
places.note: Wutong trees under the storm peaks of Thê Ngô Lĩnh, struck again and again.
